RCW 1.12.040 Computation of time. The time within which an act
is to be done, as herein provided, shall be computed by excluding the
first day, and including the last, unless the last day is a holiday,
Saturday, or Sunday, and then it is also excluded. [1997 c 125 s 1;
1887 c 20 s 1; Code 1881 s 743; 1854 p 219 s 486; RRS s 150.]
Rules of court: CR 6(a), RAP 18.6. Cf. RAP 18.22.
Reviser's note: This section has been enacted at various times as
part of "An act to regulate the practice and proceedings in civil
actions." However, Allen v. Morris, 87 Wash. 268, 274, 151 Pac. 827
(1915); State ex rel. Evans v. Superior Court, 168 Wash. 176, 179, 11
P. (2d) 229 (1932); State v. Levesque, 5 Wn. (2d) 631, 635, 106 P.
(2d) 309 (1940); and State ex rel. Early v. Batchelor, 15 Wn. (2d)
149, 130 P. (2d) 72 (1942), treat this section as being of general
application.

Certified on 7/12/2024
